children: PDS Biotechnology announced publication of Phase 2 VERSATILE-002 results showing a 39.3-month median overall survival in first-line ICI‑naïve HPV16‑positive R/M head and neck cancer patients.
VERSATILE-002 Phase 2 results published in JAMA Oncology for PDS0101 plus pembrolizumab in HPV16‑positive R/M HNSCC.
Median overall survival (mOS) was 39.3 months in the ICI‑naïve mITT cohort with CPS ≥1 (95% CI, 23.9 to NE).
Objective response rate (ORR) for CPS ≥1 was 36% by investigator review (34% by central review); includes complete responses.
Treatment was well tolerated: 13.8% Grade ≥3 treatment‑related AEs, one Grade 4 event, no Grade 5 TRAEs reported.
Company prioritizes PDS0301 in metastatic colorectal cancer while pursuing partnership strategy for PDS0101; PIPE financing initial close noted.
